readings: For each invoice number in Invoice_Line_Items, calculate the average numeric product_quantity, ignoring missing quantities. Calculate the invoice's relative gap as (the average derived_product_cost minus the average derived_total_cost) divided by the average derived_total_cost, averaging each cost column separately and ignoring missing values. Use NULL for the gap if its denominator is zero or missing. Calculate the overall average of the nonmissing invoice average quantities. Keep invoices whose average quantity exceeds that overall average. Return the invoice number, average quantity, relative gap, and average quantity minus the overall average. Sort by that difference descending, with missing values last and invoice number ascending to break ties; return the first 10 without rounding.

For each invoice number in Invoice_Line_Items, calculate the average numeric product_quantity, ignoring missing quantities. For each line item, calculate (derived_product_cost minus derived_total_cost) divided by derived_total_cost; treat the result as missing if either cost is missing or derived_total_cost is zero. The invoice's relative gap is the average of its nonmissing line-item gaps. Calculate the overall average of the nonmissing invoice average quantities. Keep invoices whose average quantity exceeds that overall average. Return the invoice number, average quantity, relative gap, and average quantity minus the overall average. Sort by that difference descending, with missing values last and invoice number ascending to break ties; return the first 10 without rounding.

For each invoice number in Invoice_Line_Items, calculate the average numeric product_quantity, ignoring missing quantities. Calculate the invoice's relative gap as (the sum of derived_product_cost minus the sum of derived_total_cost) divided by the sum of derived_total_cost, summing each cost column separately and ignoring missing values. Use NULL for the gap if its denominator is zero or missing. Calculate the overall average of the nonmissing invoice average quantities. Keep invoices whose average quantity exceeds that overall average. Return the invoice number, average quantity, relative gap, and average quantity minus the overall average. Sort by that difference descending, with missing values last and invoice number ascending to break ties; return the first 10 without rounding.
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
  SELECT
    invoice_number,
    AVG(CAST(NULLIF(TRIM(product_quantity), '') AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
    AVG(derived_product_cost) AS average_product_cost,
    AVG(derived_total_cost) AS average_total_cost
  FROM Invoice_Line_Items
  GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity
  FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
  i.invoice_number,
  i.average_quantity,
  (i.average_product_cost - i.average_total_cost)
    / NULLIF(i.average_total_cost, 0) AS relative_gap,
  i.average_quantity - o.average_quantity AS quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE i.average_quantity > o.average_quantity
ORDER BY quantity_difference DESC NULLS LAST, i.invoice_number ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
        AVG(
            CASE
                WHEN derived_product_cost IS NOT NULL
                 AND derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL
                 AND derived_total_cost <> 0
                THEN (derived_product_cost - derived_total_cost) * 1.0
                     / derived_total_cost
            END
        ) AS relative_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS average_quantity
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    i.average_quantity,
    i.relative_gap,
    i.average_quantity - o.average_quantity AS average_quantity_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o
WHERE i.average_quantity > o.average_quantity
ORDER BY
    average_quantity_difference IS NULL,
    average_quantity_difference DESC,
    i.invoice_number ASC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT
        invoice_number,
        AVG(CAST(product_quantity AS REAL)) AS average_quantity,
        (SUM(derived_product_cost) - SUM(derived_total_cost))
            / NULLIF(SUM(derived_total_cost), 0) AS relative_gap
    FROM Invoice_Line_Items
    GROUP BY invoice_number
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_quantity) AS overall_average
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    i.invoice_number,
    i.average_quantity,
    i.relative_gap,
    i.average_quantity - o.overall_average AS average_difference
FROM invoice_averages AS i
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE i.average_quantity > o.overall_average
ORDER BY average_difference DESC NULLS LAST, i.invoice_number ASC
LIMIT 10;
